sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 1（初级）)

purpose.zh: 俯卧撑加推的简单版，膝盖着地练肩胛推地
purpose.en: The easier push-up plus: knees down, train your shoulder blades to push the floor.

text.zh: 膝盖着地，手肘伸直，只动肩胛骨
text.en: Knees down, elbows straight, move only your shoulder blades

text.zh: 胸口往下沉，再把地面推开、上背拱起来。
text.en: Let your chest sink, then push the floor away and round your upper back.

text.zh: 从膝盖到头是一条斜线，屁股别撅。
text.en: Keep a straight line from knees to head, hips not up.

commonErrors.en: Bending your elbows along with it.
Piking your hips or sagging your lower back.

cautions.zh: 膝盖硌得疼就垫块毛巾
cautions.en: If your knees hurt on the floor, put a towel under them.

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 10 第一侧移重 / 14 第二侧移重（初级）
thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面＋斜后上方（同动作 1）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 同动作 1 的低阶版：3 组 × 10–12 次，休 60 秒；顶端停 1 秒
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
